issues.where: Crops 2 and 3, broad lit folds of the foreground leaves
issues.what: The folds have broad, smooth highlights that make the leaves look molded and waxy. Fine surface relief largely disappears in the lit areas.
issues.fix: Break up the sheen with fine leaf-surface relief and local roughness variation, especially between the veins.

issues.where: Crop 4, arched leaf extending to the lower right
issues.what: Past the lit fold, the long blade reads as a near-black strip with a thin bright outline rather than as tissue with varying thickness.
issues.fix: Carry a little transmitted light through the thin parts of the blade, retaining darker veins and varying the edge thickness and curl.

issues.where: Crops 2 and 4, lit edge of the main stem beneath the middle leaf junction
issues.what: The backlit hairs merge into a coarse, nearly continuous white fringe that loses the shape of individual fibers.
issues.fix: Taper the fibers, break up their spacing and length, and reduce the hottest rim highlights so individual strands still separate at delivery size.

issues.where: Crops 5 and 6, ridge along the skyline behind the field
issues.what: The ridge reads as a flat silhouette, particularly on the right, where a scalloped contour and a narrow notch border a largely uniform dark mass.
issues.fix: Break up the contour and add subtle depth and tonal separation between ridge forms without bringing the background into focus.
